display_name: Framed listing image: thin oak floater frame with a narrow shadow gap around the artwork, no mat, soft shadow
purpose: For work framed without a mat, such as canvases (B-080). Same frame, canvas and shadow as framed-oak-white-mat; the canvas floats in the frame with a narrow gap (B-084). The artwork is placed unchanged, so this derivative is not consequential.
measured_from: Owner's framed portrait example, 1024 x 1536 (2026-10-27). Mat and frame ratios are relative to the artwork's displayed width.

canvas.note: The canvas follows the artwork's shape (owner: about 95% of artworks are square, portrait or landscape). Portrait is measured from the owner's example; square and landscape keep its margins.

mat.note: No mat: a floater frame. The gap between the canvas and the oak is about 1.8% of the artwork's width, in a shadowed oak tone (owner's floater example, 2026-11-11).

texture.note: A straight run of the top bar of a blank oak frame image. The image is a local asset (.commerce-os/assets/oak-frame.png), not committed.
